title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Ahmad WP Job…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Ahmad WP Job Portal (wp-job-portal) versions up to and including 2.7.2. This vulnerability arises from improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing attackers with low privileges and requiring user interaction to execute malicious scripts in the context of affected users. The vulnerability has a CVSS 3.1 base score of 6.5, indicating medium severity.
